title: Lake DeSoto Farmers Market
where: Wilson Park, Lake City, FL (between Shands Hospital & Columbia County Courthouse)
blurb: Weekly farmers market with local produce, vendors, and community goods. Open every Saturday year-round.

title: 6th Annual Community Day
blurb: City of Lake City's 6th Annual Community Day — free family event with activities, vendors, and community resources.

title: Boots & Badges Charity Basketball Tournament
where: Columbia County Fairgrounds, Lake City, FL
blurb: Annual charity basketball tournament presented by Columbia County Sheriff's Office & LCPD. Cheer on local first responders competing for a year of bragging rights while supporting community causes.

title: Cornerstone Care Clinic: Grand Opening & Ribbon Cutting
where: Cornerstone Care Clinic, Lake City, FL
blurb: Grand opening and ribbon cutting ceremony for Cornerstone Care Clinic's new Lake City location.

title: Citizens Police Academy
where: Lake City Police Department, Lake City, FL
blurb: Free 10-week program giving attendees an inside view into LCPD operations. Starts August 13, meets Thursday evenings.

title: Growers & Makers Market
where: Olustee Park, Downtown Lake City, FL
blurb: Local artisans, growers, and food vendors. Held 2nd & 4th Saturdays monthly (Mar, Apr, Jun, Sep, Oct, Nov).
recurrence: 2nd & 4th Saturday (Mar, Apr, Jun, Sep, Oct, Nov)

title: Florida Gateway Fair & Livestock Show
where: Florida Gateway Fairgrounds, 164 SW Mary Ethel Ln, Lake City, FL 32025
blurb: 72nd annual fair with rides, livestock shows, live entertainment, fair food, and family attractions. Runs Oct 30 – Nov 8, 2026.
